remarks: A RARE, SPACIOUS and PREMIER Townhouse in desirable Wilton Crest awaits the next lucky buyers. Upon walking in, this light-filled home will captivate you as one may feel as if they have entered an art gallery! The stunning living room with vaulted ceiling, hardwood floors, cozy fireplace and sliders leading to deck/balcony is truly inviting. Turnkey and custom kitchen with Brookhaven cabinetry, tile backsplash, Bosch appliances and quartz counters was designed with careful attention to detail. Sun-drenched dining room with huge windows, custom built-ins and hardwood floors is perfect for your next dinner party. Walk in to the Primary bedroom suite with sliders, leading out to patio/terrace and you will find ample closets and gorgeous bathroom with large walk in shower, two sinks and tile floor. A second bedroom suite with another deck, ample closet area and renovated full bath can also be found on the first floor. Inviting Foyer and new laundry with custom cabinets and sink complete the main level. Upstairs you will find the third full bath and bedroom/office/studio. AND, if that isn't enough, the finished lower level leading to garage offers ample storage, workshop & family/recreation room. This incredible home with two ensuite first floor bedrooms, cool angles, ceiling heights, & fabulous skylights throughout is chic, unique & alluring in so many ways. One of a kind end unit in a quiet location, offers a lifestyle of convenience & low maintenance. Incredible opportunity!
